name: AutoShorts · Video Factory
summary: Local Cinema preparation, model-specific Pika/H3 prompts, reviewed reference images, native dialogue, optional narration, RelayVSR and FFmpeg exports.
notes: Native pipeline: use /api/autoshorts or the autoshorts MCP tool; capabilities exposes schemas and model recipes. prepare/produce generate missing canonical images, enter waiting_review, then compose reviewed keyframes before footage. waiting_review is normal, not an inference error. Ref2VA receives ordered canonical images and a composition image; FL2VA receives opening and optional ending keyframes. Local model-specific prompt compilation follows the official Pika/H3 guidance, with native speaker-attributed dialogueLines. Cinema defaults to native dialogue/sound; TTS is explicit opt-in. A vertical-drama direction preset is experimental. keepAudio:false mutes native sound; speechMode:mute mutes both. Readiness and exact bound prompts are visible before video; exports include provenance.json. Existing engines use the shared queue/history/runner. No hosted rewriter, guaranteed visual identity, guaranteed voice identity, or guaranteed lip sync.
